prompt: A package weighs $2$ lb $8$ oz. How many **total ounces**? ($1$ lb $= 16$ oz)
hint: The weight is given in two different units. Only the pounds need converting, because the $8$ ounces are already in ounces.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Split the weight into two pieces, the pounds and the leftover ounces. Deal with each piece on its own, then put them back together.
The weight is given in two different units. Only the pounds need converting, because the $8$ ounces are already in ounces.
Change the pounds first: $2 \times 16 = 32$ ounces. Then add on the extra $8$ ounces.
$32 + 8 = 40$, so the package weighs $40$ ounces in total.

explanation: Convert the pounds to ounces using $1$ pound $= 16$ ounces: $2 \times 16 = 32$ ounces.
The remaining $8$ ounces are already in the right unit, so they stay as they are.
Add the two amounts because together they make the whole weight: $32 + 8 = 40$.
The package weighs a total of $40$ ounces.
